description: The chart illustrates the F1 scores of various models across six datasets, comparing their performance in anomaly detection tasks. The horizontal axis lists the categories, labeled as SMD, PSM, SWaT, SMAP, MSL, and WADI, in a fixed order. The vertical axis is labeled "F1 Score (%)", with a linear scale ranging from 60 to 100, marked at intervals of 10. Each dataset is represented by a group of four bars, colored green, blue, purple, and brown, corresponding to the models MADLLM, MADLLM w/o prompt pool, MADLLM w/o feature embedding, and MADLLM w/o skip embedding, respectively. The green bars (MADLLM) consistently show the highest or near-highest values across all datasets, with scores ranging from approximately 74 for WADI to 93 for SMD. The other models exhibit varying performance, with the blue bars (MADLLM w/o prompt pool) generally showing the lowest values, particularly for SMAP and WADI, with scores around 69 and 63, respectively. The bars within each group are not sorted, but the datasets are presented in a consistent order. No bars are visually emphasized beyond their color coding.
